parties: D. Vijaysen Reddy (acquirer) | Prajay Engineers Syndicate Limited
headline: D. Vijaysen Reddy files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure for substantial acquisition in Prajay Engineers
sum: D. Vijaysen Reddy has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4) with the NSE regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in Prajay Engineers Syndicate Limited.
detail: The disclosure was submitted to NSE on 8 May 2026 and relates to a substantial acquisition of shares or voting rights in Prajay Engineers Syndicate Limited. Under SEBI's Takeover Regulations 2011, any person acquiring 25% or more of shares (or committed to acquire such stake) must disclose within two trading days. The filing triggers standard takeover code gates: public announcement within 4 working days, open offer at fair value within 60 days, and potential creeping acquisition exemptions if applicable.
